NOW, THEREFORE, I, CORAZON C. AQUINO, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order:
SECTION 1. The annual assistance for infrastructure projects, based on
the formula recommended by the Oversight Committee, shall be in the
amount of Six hundred fifteen million (P615,000,000.00) starting fiscal year
1991 to 1995 in accordance with the requirements of Republic Act No. 6734

The Department of Budget and Management (DDM) is hereby
ordered to incorporate Six hundred fifteen million pesos (P615,000,000.00) for

- 2 -
the aforesaid annual assistance for infrastructure projects in the budget
message of the President for five years, starting with fiscal year 1991, and issue
the necessary guidelines for budgetary releases therefor.

The Department of Budget and Management, in consultation
with the Autonomous Regional Government, shall automatically adjust the
amount of annual assistance in the event of accession by other provinces in
Mindanao based on the aforecited formula.
Autonomous Regional Government may source
additional financing for its infrastructure program, on a project proposal
basis, from the official development assistance extended by the National
Government within the jurisdiction of the Committee on Official
Development Assistance subject to its rules and regulations.

The Coordinating Council of the Philippine Assistance
Trogram shall assist the Autonomous Regional Government in funding and
formulating feasibility and other technical studies.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediatelv.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 12th day of October, in the year of our
Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
By the President:
